effective_rules: machine output is a candidate list with rule hit and source evidence, never a semantic verdict
public, shared, high-risk, duplicate candidate and retired candidate use the approved evidence boundaries
terminal-name match, underscore convention, static-reference absence or module-path name alone cannot decide a classification
Reusable Routine Ledger registration and reuse disposition require a later Human confirmation
permitted_next_action: approved classification rulesのcontaining commit後、candidate extractorのAcceptance TestをREDから作成する。
prohibited_next_action: candidate classificationをfinal VerdictまたはLedger登録として扱う
call graph、risk classifier、Test reference parserの仕様をHuman判断なしに拡張する
